## Context / Problem
Five Terraform/deployment files contain repeated, historical, or stale comments identified by the audit and revalidated on current `origin/main`. `user_data.sh` comments are parsed by Terraform `templatefile()`, so comment edits can break rendering even when shell behavior is unchanged.

## Approach
Edit only standalone comments and blank lines in the declared files. Preserve HCL/shell values, Terraform escapes, proof markers, and ShellCheck directives byte-for-byte unless rewording ordinary prose.

## Scope
- `opcert-plan-assertions.sh` — Preserve post-apply no-change assertions for computed values, credentials, usage, address-scoped checks, and write-only-key proof.
- `opcert.tf` — Preserve existing-host/pay-per-request architecture, SigV4 plus origin guard, exact invoke grant, operator-managed trust list, operator-seeded write-only Ed25519 key, Terraform-managed origin guard, two-step guard rotation, and brief fail-closed 403 window.
- `ssm.tf` — Preserve boot-fatal versus optional MCP/Jira secrets, file-materialized credentials versus environment values, operator-owned Jira URL/user versus Terraform-owned project, write-only SecureStrings, exact consumers, and adoption imports.
- `user_data.sh` — Preserve device fallback; volume IDs limited to `vol-` plus 8 or 17 hex digits; empty/truncated rejection; whole-token NVMe serial match; missing-filesystem-UUID rejection before `/etc/fstab`; loud scratch-mount failure; root/volume proof markers; excluded OAuth parameters; exact `REFUSE-DEGENERATE-VOLUME-ID` and `REFUSE-EMPTY-FILESYSTEM-UUID` markers; exact ShellCheck directives; and `$${...}` escapes required even inside comments.
- `versions.tf` — Preserve Terraform >=1.11 write-only values, >=1.10 locking, unsafe older clients, AWS provider write-only SSM support, and random/archive consumers.

Consumers are Terraform, cloud-init, security/operators, ShellCheck, template-escape checks, and mutation tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The leaf commit changes only standalone comments or blank lines in the five declared files; markers, directives, and Terraform escapes remain exact.
- [ ] Every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations in a leaf-linked session log authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [ ] Every edited comment block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row confirming that redundant, obvious, duplicated, historical, or stale prose was removed while current non-obvious rationale remained.
- [ ] Focused op-cert/SSM/device/template tests, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and repository lint pass; no missing or FAIL semantic-preservation row remains.

## Verification
Run the recorded comment-only guard, focused Terraform/deployment suites, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv lint.
